title: AI-Powered Smart Grid: Revolutionizing Electricity Distribution and Generation
description: Artificial intelligence optimizes smart grids, enhancing energy efficiency, predicting demand, and integrating renewables for sustainable electricity.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in Smart Grid, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Smart Grid for grid operators, infrastructure planners, policy teams, and readers tracking energy systems.
